Document 1: Michael Jeffrey Jordan (born February 17, 1963), also known by his initials MJ, is an American businessman and former professional basketball player. He played 15 seasons in the National Basketball Association (NBA) between 1984 and 2003, winning six NBA championships with the Chicago Bulls. He was integral in popularizing basketball and the NBA around the world in the 1980s and 1990s, becoming a global cultural icon.

Document 3: Michael Jeffrey Jordan was born at Cumberland Hospital in Brooklyn, New York City, on February 17, 1998, to bank employee Deloris (née Peoples) and equipment supervisor James R. Jordan Sr. He has two older brothers, James Jr. and Larry, as well as an older sister named Deloris and a younger sister named Roslyn. Jordan and his siblings were raised Methodist.

Question: What is the occupation of Manuel da Cruz?
Document 1: As the sun set over the rolling hills of rural France, Manuel da Cruz, a man of the cloth, made his way through the winding streets of the small village. His worn, black boots clicked against the cobblestone pavement, a rhythmic accompaniment to the soft rustling of his priestly robes. The villagers, familiar with the Portuguese prelate's gentle nature, nodded in respect as he passed, their faces creasing into warm smiles. Manuel's duties as a priest often took him beyond the confines of the village church, into the surrounding countryside. Today, he was bound for the Château de la Roche, where the local lord, Monsieur le Comte, had requested his presence. The Comte, a just and fair man, was known for his generosity towards the villagers, and Manuel had grown fond of him over the years. As he approached the château, Manuel noticed a group of men gathered near the entrance, their faces etched with concern. They were the anciens cadres, a socio-professional category of experienced professionals who had served the Comte and his family for generations. Manuel recognized several of them, including Monsieur Dupont, the Comte's trusted advisor, and Monsieur LaFleur, the château's master gardener. The men parted as Manuel approached, their eyes flicking towards him with a mixture of curiosity and respect. "Bonjour, Monsieur le Prêtre," Monsieur Dupont said, his voice low and gravelly. "The Comte awaits you. We have... a situation, of sorts." Manuel's curiosity was piqued, but he merely nodded and followed the men into the château. As they walked, he couldn't help but notice the way the anciens cadres moved with a quiet confidence, their years of service and experience evident in every step. It was a quality he admired, one that he, too, had cultivated over the years. In the grand hall, the Comte sat behind a large, oak desk, his face lined with worry. "Manuel, my friend," he said, his voice laced with urgency. "I fear we have a problem on our hands. One of our villagers, a young woman named Sophie, has gone missing. Her family is frantic, and I fear the worst." Manuel's eyes met those of the anciens cadres, and he sensed a subtle understanding pass between them.
